stem: A facility experiences recurring pest introductions in the cleanest production rooms. Plant intake is controlled, but staff move from outdoor work directly into those rooms. Which hypothesis deserves priority?
choices: Personnel movement may be bypassing the intended zone barrier and should be evaluated as a repeat transfer pathway
The intake program must be the sole cause
The pest pressure proves room temperature is wrong
rationale: When one pathway is controlled but another cross-zone pathway remains, personnel movement becomes a plausible recurring introduction route.
